title: [I17:E01] Skill Models: Validate Heading Procedures and HTML Invocations
body:
## Overview

Skills select their document model through structure declarations. The shared checker validates heading procedures and HTML invocations for the selected model, with Work Planner's installed adoption reserved for its final conversion task.

## Changes

The declared-model checks cover the proposed Work Planner presentation while its live documents keep their selected model.

### Declared Models

- **Structure selection.**
  Explicit file entries select entry layouts; typed options describe heading steps, preambles, field contracts and call verbs.
- **Procedure contracts.**
  Step sequences follow their parent procedure, and Inputs/Outputs resolve the owning artifact's field contracts.

### Invocation Reading

- **Literal command payload.**
  One lexical reader owns Markdown fences and HTML invocations, preserving shell text and required bold argument links.
- **Execution and interfaces.**
  Invocations sit in their executing step, with GraphQL REST-gap evidence scoped there and Projects V2 checks preserved.

title: [I17:E01] Skill Style: The Groundwork for Prosiform Compliance
body:
## Overview

Work Planner separates numbered procedures from enriched command specifications. Commands precedes Fields; each command owns its input/output links and invocation, while callers retain selections, guards and result handling. Single-reference artifact operations and redundant command-forwarding operations are part of their callers; shared operations remain with their owning artifacts. Installed declarations select the shared checker and the corpus readers that enforce those boundaries.

## Changes

### Shared Validation

- **Declared models.** Exact-file and family declarations select headings, preambles, command specifications, Field contracts, role tags and Run/Apply/Follow routing.
- **Literal boundaries.** One lexical reader isolates fenced and HTML payloads while recognizing explicit bold command annotations and specification placement.
- **Contract interpretation.** Command specifications own input/output contracts at actual parameter or prose use. Checks reject duplicate nested contracts, redundant forwarding wrappers, repeated parent titles and invocations outside Commands.

### Instruction Corpus

- **Field examples.** Linked Fields own value, payload and output examples written as `eg` with inline code. Structural templates and formatting demonstrations keep their fenced layout. Command specifications carry generic invocations and meaningful usage conditions, including the hot-fix draft flag.
- **Command contracts.** Each command opens with an imperative action and linked provided results and recipient. Its specification retains linked parameters, preconditions and authorization. Nested calls identify meaningful selections and evidence transitions without repeating the parameter inventory. A sole prose condition accompanies the preamble without a bullet; genuine multi-item detail lists follow the invocation.
- **Command presentation.** Shell continuations and line-leading output redirections use HTML entities to preserve literal characters inside one rendered command block. Paths, refs, text and expressions retain required quotes; validated shell-safe values remain unquoted.
- **Common context.** Rules, Conventions and Configuration have focused homes. rules.md defines runtime link roles once; guidelines link that definition.
- **Contained items.** Steps with several instruction/detail items bullet every item; a sole item uses plain prose. Called operations, protocols and procedures carry ƒ; explicit results use Provide.

- **Data contracts.** Fields identify scalars/references, documents, collections or composite objects. Lane exposes separate flat assignment-read, unit-validation and admission results with explicit null, finding and exit semantics. Start evidence is concrete data; queue jurisdiction and lifecycle policy are not implied inputs. The authoring guideline and prerequisite consumer check preserve this distinction.

- **Context through links.** Modes, protocols and artifacts select needed context through in-text links and their reading boundaries. Prerequisites inventories and automatic preload rules are absent. Explicit whole-document instructions, common Rules/Conventions, actual execution gates and delivery dependencies remain.

### Consuming Readers

- **Installed authority.** Corpus readers use the declared specification model and shared role grammar while retaining script-reach, link/contract, literal-exclusion and obligation checks.
- **Checkout propagation.** Checkout acceptance follows authoritative command contracts through procedural calls. Logical command lines retain checkout, revision, registration and publication assertions, including real-git placement tests.

### Instruction Preservation

- **Single-use composition.** Thirty-five artifact operations have one linked reference and are inlined at that caller; 65 remain shared. Record Dispatch Status retains four references. Conditions, loops, decisions and completion handling remain explicit, with corrected readiness/refusal continuations and a corpus reference-count gate. All 116 command specifications remain. Current Fields describe data values; single-use rules are inline and shared policies have one Guidance home. The field sweep preserves every invocation block and nine literal templates against its recorded baseline.
- **Observed regressions.** Comparing the pre-E01 source found empty selection values dropped by shell parsing, missing initiative output and formatter-context flags, a missing post-repair delivery survey, and ambiguous stale-index conditional scope. Command owners and procedures now carry those instructions explicitly.
- **Behavioral evidence.** Documented command fixtures verify optional selections, output paths, reservation dates, repeated base revisions, Development evidence and actual Lane result examples. The current full planner suite runs 946 tests: 945 pass and one opt-in check is skipped. The retired test required duplicate prerequisite inventories. All 280 shared checker tests pass; the installed model reports 58 files and zero findings.
- **Review boundary.** The comparison traces all 116 original generic command specifications, field moves and critical delivery/planning/synchronization gates. It does not establish live tracker or GitNexus correctness. Prerequisite cleanup remains planned in E02, and this integration PR remains draft.
